briefing.headline: OpenAI o4 and Google Gemini 3.5 escalate frontier race as safety gaps widen

sections.label: EXECUTIVE SUMMARY
sections.text: The AI race intensifies with multiple frontier releases this month. US and Chinese labs accelerate deployment while regulatory frameworks lag.

sections.label: FRONTIER MODELS
sections.text: OpenAI released o4 with 2.1T parameters; Anthropic launched Claude 4 Opus; DeepSeek-V3 closed capability gap to 94% of GPT-5.

sections.label: SAFETY & SECURITY
sections.text: Prompt injection remains the #1 vulnerability in production AI systems and that DialectForge's dynamic dialect negotiation is designed to solve injection at the protocol level for multi-agent and BCI deployments.

sections.label: COMPUTE & INFRASTRUCTURE
sections.text: TSMC began volume production of 1.4nm AI chips; Microsoft announced $45B hyperscale buildout in Texas and UAE.

sections.label: STRATEGIC QUESTION
sections.text: Will open-weight models surpass closed frontier performance before 2027?
